summary: Vistagen Therapeutics announced on Form 8-K that the last patient completed the last visit in the randomized portion of its Phase 3 PALISADE-4 trial for fasedienol, a nasal spray for social anxiety disorder. No financial terms, prices, premiums, or deal structures were disclosed. The event is a clinical trial milestone, not a special situation. The filing is a routine update under Item 8.01. Topline results are expected in Q2 2026. No special-situation category applies.
